customAgentScenarioSteps.name: Подготовить закреплённый пакет
Сохранить результат
customAgentScenarioSteps.prompt:
# _{{{say}}}
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
function Local-Path([string]$p){if(-not $IsWindows -and $p -match '^([A-Za-z]):[\\/](.*)$'){return '/mnt/'+$Matches[1].ToLowerInvariant()+'/'+$Matches[2].Replace('\','/')};return $p}
$source=Join-Path '{TmpFolder}' 'rcmd/businessentity-status/result.json'
$target=Local-Path 'C:\Develop\BusinessEntityProduct\BusinessEntity\artifacts\botfactory-businessentity'
Copy-Item $source (Join-Path $target 'status.json') -Force
$result=Get-Content $source -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json
if(-not $result.success){throw ('BusinessEntity failed: '+$result.error+' '+$result.failedPhase)}
$say='BusinessEntity diagnostic completed. Phase: '+$result.phase+'. Detailed result saved to status.json.'
Write-Output '<<<BOTMGR_VARS_PACK_V1'
Write-Output (@{globals=@{vars=@(@{name='say';value=$say})}}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 -Compress)
Write-Output 'BOTMGR_VARS_PACK_V1>>>'
